# Region Map of the PAC-MAN Program (heuristic)

**Status: Implemented, hints only.** Generated by `python -I tools/region_map.py <body.bin> 4000`.
Addresses are *runtime* addresses (file address + $3000; see REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md section 6).

Method: per 256-byte page, measure zero bytes, how much of a linear disassembly is valid 6502 opcodes,
and whether JSR/JMP operands land in the program, ROM or zero page. Code and data are clearly interleaved,
and a page-sized view cannot separate them. **Do not treat any label as a finding** until the area is
confirmed by control-flow disassembly or emulator tracing.

Summary of the 107 pages ($4000-$AAFF): 58 data?, 35 code?, 9 mixed, 4 sparse data (zero-heavy: $6600-$6800, $7F00).
Nothing is fully empty. The last page, $A900, is a partial page.
